senses.gloss: m. (אָמַד) estimate, guess, measuring by mere sight, approximate assessment; medical opinion as to the nature of injuries.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 54b:12">Men. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>ניטלת בא׳</he> may be set apart (for the priest) by estimating (without measuring) the quantity.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:5">Snh. IV, 5</cite> <he>מא׳ ומשמועה</he> from mere supposition or hear-say.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78b:12">Ib. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>אין א׳ אחר א׳</he> the first estimate (medical opinion declaring an inflicted injury fatal) cannot be upset by a second more favorable opinion (if erroneously formed under the resemblance of recovery); v. <cite ref="A01984"><he>אָמַד</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ האמצעי</he> the (second) opinion intermediate between the first opinion and the actual fatal result.
